definitions.gloss: heavy feeling in the stomach; indigestion
definitions.explanation: The uncomfortable, heavy feeling of food sitting undigested in the stomach, typically after eating too much or eating rich, oily food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べすぎて{胃|い}もたれ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ate too much fried food and got indigestion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{脂|あぶら}っこい→脂っこい：14728_aburakkoi⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{胃|い}もたれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Since I got older, when I eat greasy food the heavy feeling in my stomach lasts until the next day.

notes:
From ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧ (stomach) + もたれる (to sit heavily). The verb form ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もたれる (my stomach feels heavy) is just as common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃|い}もたれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a heavy stomach
- {胃|い}もたれ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get indigestion
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧もたれる: one's stomach feels heavy
- {胃|い}もたれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: medicine for indigestion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{胸焼|むねや}け→胸焼け：22809_muneyake⟧: heartburn — a burning feeling in the chest rather than heaviness
